A '''Shiraya fan headdress''' was a type of [[Hat/Legends|headress]] associated with the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] culture.<ref name="Episode I VD" /> It shared a name with the ancient moon goddess [[Shiraya/Legends|Shiraya]].<ref name="ROTS VD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

[[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] wore one on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that had a [[Color/Legends|dark brown]] crest, and white [[Veda pearl/Legends|veda pearl]] beading; [[Glass/Legends|glass]] filaments in [[Suspensa/Legends|strands]] on either side of her face<ref name="Episode I VD" /> formed a "veil of tears."<ref name="FF 29">{{FactFile2014|29|GAR 1-4|Naboo Royal Garments}}</ref> Queen [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]] wore a Shiraya fan headdress to Amidala's [[Padmé Amidala's funeral/Legends|funeral]].<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref>

{{Clothes-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Shiraya fan headdresses were invented for the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], and were first identified in the associated reference book [[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary|''Star Wars: Episode I The Visual Dictionary'']], which was written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]].<ref name="Episode I VD" />
